protocol: single_run_diagnostic; use experiment runner for inferential results

utilization_definitions.service: setup + manual handling + automatic processing; excludes waiting
utilization_definitions.occupied: all non-idle machine states, including waiting for service
utilization_definitions.denominator: calendar minutes in measurement window per machine; excludes drain

setup_wait_definition: Requests whose setup service starts in the measurement window; includes waits begun in warmup, excludes still-pending requests. Not an uncensored all-request mean.
setup_transition_rule: Distinct operation identity with zero class transition uses lightest positive configured setup tier; same-operation continuation unchanged. Engineering assumption.

model_provenance.routes: Six source-informed skeletons; 16 synthetic multi-operation variants and two singles. Roles and axes are engineering choices.
model_provenance.mix: 95% inverse-rank over explicit16-family ranking, 5% single-operation split equally. Synthetic, not fitted Pareto.
model_provenance.quantities: Approved bounded triangular mean175 after probability normalization; role-independent relative size classes. Not observed market quantities.
model_provenance.processing: Source family median standard proxies; synthetic fixed complexity and role modifiers, not isolated autonomous measurements.
model_provenance.machines: 68 retained coordinates; two Honing/two WireEDM; remaining64 apportioned to Milling/Turning by fixed reference processing plus on-machine manual service. Source positions preserved where possible.
model_provenance.axes: 3/4 requirement dominates eligibility; four-axis pool from required workload plus20 percentage-point flexible reserve. Extra axes not a speed factor.
model_provenance.setup: Three role-based synthetic setup classes per process; fixed transition type; triangular duration; four fixed setup staff.
model_provenance.workers: Offline manual-capacity sizing with20% transfer allowance; 2:1day/night ratio per floor; fixed employees, not demand-reactive.
model_provenance.floor: Workers remain on own floor; parts use finite shared freight lift. Three minutes per lift trip is engineering baseline.
model_provenance.arrivals: Fixed exogenous Poisson, rate chosen offline; no live balancing.
model_provenance.single_operation_share: 5% engineering baseline, preserves small simple-work representation independently of multi-operation rank law.

flow_reference.definition: Quantity times sum of fastest eligible per-unit processing time for every sequential operation. Excludes queues, setup, handling, transport, shifts and contention. Not an attained or proven optimum. Valid for the current no-split sequential-route model.

routing_semantics: FIFO pooled queue; ECT over all eligible machines with virtual queued workload; first-service reservation commits machine
